fields.name: localHeader
fields.comment: Starts at offset 0; not for empty ZIPs or self-extracting archives with a leading executable

fields.name: signature
fields.comment: Local file header signature is validated

fields.name: crc32
fields.comment: May be 0 when flag bit 3 is set; no checksum validation is performed

fields.name: compressedSize
fields.comment: May be deferred or the ZIP64 sentinel 4294967295

fields.name: uncompressedSize
fields.comment: ZIP64 extra data is not interpreted

fields.name: fileNameBytes
fields.comment: Raw encoded filename bytes; parser node limits apply

fields.name: extraFieldBytes
fields.comment: Raw extra bytes only; compressed data and central directory are not parsed
